subject: Hmm
author: Drifter Jon
body:
hmm, maybe thats why. I googled it and websites are now saying the 28th. Maybe thats why the store told me it was delayed. Whats anoying now is that everyone was told the 25th, and GAME.co.uk still says the 25th. I've emailed game, so i guess we'll just have to wait and see.

To be continued...

Sigh

EDIT: (also, on the car topic, on some sites it says there is a cheat code to unlock the steel wheels car, only you have to earn a certain license uprgade until you can actually drive it. Im guessing the code you get if you pre order you can use it rom the start) If thats the case, i'll probably by it from the local store instead.

subject: Email them..
author: ZombieTron
body:
Hopefully they will still be able to resolve the problem and still send you Paradise in time for Friday. I was a little concerned today that burnout.ea.com were giving the Europe release date as the 28th??

I know a few UK friends who have the game already, try asking at your friendly independent retailer if you have no joy with GAME, you never know you might get to visit Paradise City a couple of days early!
